does_not_do: Its model weights are free only for research, personal use and organisations under 5 million dollars in funding or revenue; other commercial use needs a paid licence.
focus_reason: Output quality targets the need, but the weights' licence differs from the code's. 4 releases in the year; 80 open issues.
measured_against: Need: turn statements and filings (PDF and office files) into text and tables a program can read, locally.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory and a CI workflow.
what_it_is: Converts PDF, image, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, HTML and EPUB files to Markdown, JSON or HTML, including tables and equations, on GPU, CPU or MPS.
